hotels.title: Five-Star Oceanfront Vietnam Retreat with Rooftop Bar & Private Beach
hotels.description: Luxuriate for days at this five-star oceanfront retreat overlooking a private golden stretch of sand lining the South China Sea. Head to one of four onsite restaurants, digging into international dishes at Market Place or authentic Vietnamese seafood at Moomba. Upper Deck serves refreshing drinks on the rooftop overlooking the ocean and mountain range. For a dose of relaxation, escape to the resort's tranquil spa or stretch out in the yoga pavilion. Or for an active escape, explore three UNESCO World Heritage sites nearby - Hoi An Ancient Town, The Imperial Citadel of Hue and My Son Sanctuary.

hotels.title: Central Vietnam Pool Villa Luxury with Five Rounds of Golf, Daily Breakfast & Specialty Dining
hotels.description: World-class golf meets five-star luxury with this exclusive stay in the heart of Vietnam. Check into the stunning Banyan Tree Lăng Cô for pool villa luxury - tucked in a white-sand bay between Hue, Da Nang and Hoi An - and enjoy rounds at three curated, top-rated courses. Relax, indulge and navigate the fairways of Laguna Golf Lăng Cô, an 18-hole championship course designed by Sir Nick Faldo, the seaside Golden Sands, designed by Jack Nicklaus and touted as one of Vietnam’s most challenging and enjoyable courses and the Luke Donald-designed Ba Na Hills, set amid the mountains. There’s also plenty onsite for non-golfers to enjoy, between the dreamy spa, cooking classes and yoga.
